sentences.text: “I want to get fit,” he said.
Biff and Chip went with Dad.
He wanted to do the Fun Run.
“But it's a long way to run!”
“Dad is going to do a Fun Run,” said Biff.
“It's to help Children in Need,” said Chip.
It was the day of the Fun Run.
They all went to the park.
“It's a long way to run,” said Chip.
“Go!” called a man and the Fun Run began.
The Fun Run went around the park.
“Ten times round the park,” said Dad.
He ran round the park four times.
There was still a long way to go.
Dad's foot went into a hole.
A man looked at Dad's foot.
Dad couldn't finish the Fun Run.
“Now I can't help Children in Need.”
“We can push you in the old pram,” he said.
Wilf and his mum ran home.
They got the old pram and ran back with it.
“We will all push you,” said Mum.
They pushed him round the park.
“But it's a long way to push a pram,” said Mum.
It was the end of the run.
The wheels came off the pram.
“What a way to end the run,” said Dad.
“That was a fun run,” said Kipper.
“But it was a long way to push a dad!”
